sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('46c815f6-7a3d-43a3-b470-3377b126ba09', 'f7b6a720-05a7-4d6a-9200-21bdc90fc1c4') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
